{"id":"fedistract-rr9g.6","title":"Create fedi-ucan crate: capability delegation via UCANs","description":"UCAN (User Controlled Authorization Networks) tokens for cryptographic capability delegation between DID-identified actors.

Backwards-compatible: capabilities are carried as bearer tokens in AP request headers or embedded in activity objects. Servers that don't understand UCANs fall back to standard AP authorization (actor == sender). Aware servers can verify delegation chains.

Use cases:
1. Bot delegation: 'Bot B (did:key:B) can Create posts as User A (did:key:A) until 2025-01-01'
2. Cross-server moderation: 'Moderator M can Delete posts on behalf of Admin A'
3. Scheduled posts: 'Cron job C can publish pre-approved posts as User U'
4. Team accounts: 'Any member of org O can post as the org persona'

UCAN structure (JWT-like):
- Header: { alg: 'EdDSA', typ: 'JWT', ucv: '0.10.0' }
- Payload: {
    iss: 'did:key:issuer',    // who grants the capability
    aud: 'did:key:audience',  // who receives it
    exp: 1234567890,          // expiration (Unix seconds)
    att: [{                   // attenuations (what's allowed)
      with: 'https://example.com/users/alice',
      can: 'ap/create'       // namespaced capability
    }],
    prf: ['parent-ucan-cid'] // proof chain (delegation from parent)
  }
- Signature: Ed25519 over header.payload

Public API:
- UcanBuilder::new(issuer_did, issuer_key) -> UcanBuilder
    .for_audience(audience_did)
    .with_capability(resource, action)
    .expires_at(timestamp)
    .delegated_from(parent_ucan)  // optional chaining
    .sign() -> Result<Ucan>

- verify_ucan(token: &str, resolver: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<[u8; 32]>) -> Result<UcanPayload>
  Verify signature chain, check expiration, return parsed payload.
  Resolver maps did:key -> public key bytes.

- check_capability(ucan: &UcanPayload, resource: &str, action: &str) -> bool
  Check if the UCAN grants the requested capability (respecting attenuation).

Capability namespace for AP:
- ap/create — create posts
- ap/delete — delete posts
- ap/update — edit posts  
- ap/follow — send follow requests
- ap/moderate — moderate content (delete, suspend)
- ap/admin — full administrative access

Deps: ed25519-dalek, fedi-did, serde, serde_json, base64.

Security notes:
- Capabilities are attenuated: a delegated UCAN can only have equal or fewer permissions than its parent.
- Expiration is mandatory — no permanent delegations.
- Revocation: UCANs are bearer tokens. Revocation requires a revocation list (out of scope for v1, but the crate should define the RevocationList trait).
- Clock skew: allow 60-second grace period on expiration checks.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"mark@wolfssl.com","created_at":"2026-07-20T02:55:06.06284069Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-07-20T02:55:06.06284069Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"fedistract-rr9g.6","depends_on_id":"fedistract-rr9g","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-07-20T02:55:06.074267714Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
